newsitem.title: USA: Universal Outdoor files 4.8 mln shr offer. [CORRECTED 3:23 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Universal Outdoor files 4.8 mln shr offer. [CORRECTED 3:23 GMT]

text.p: Universal Outdoor Holdings Inc, which operates 33,000 advertising displays in 24 cities, said Thursday it registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed 4.8 million common share offering.
Of the total, 1,328,000 primary shares and 3,427,000 secondary shares will be sold by certain affiliates and related parties at Kelso & Co.
(Corrects totals of primary and secondary shares, which were reversed).
Underwriters are led by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc; Bear, Stearns Co Inc; and Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp.
No other information was immediately available.
